paraphrase: The essence of the Buddha-dhamma is to experience impermanence (anicca) within one's own body as the arising and dissolving of subtle material units; this awareness leads to the understanding of suffering and not-self and, maintained, to nibbāna.
translation_basis: paraphrase made by the unit author from the Pali where the passage was read locally; otherwise from the author's knowledge of the text
